Zhang Jie's leader notices that Zhang Jie always comes late to work recently. One day, the leader asks him, "Zhang Jie, do you know what time the first bus of the company arrives at the station every day?"

[Question]
What is the real intention of the leader when he says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. The leader is asking Zhang Jie if he knows the operating time of the company bus.
B. The leader wants Zhang Jie to be responsible for the upcoming bus scheduling work.
C. The leader is reminding Zhang Jie that he should arrive at the company earlier and should not be late anymore.
D. The leader is testing Zhang Jie's observation and memory.
